name: 16 oz Plastic Stadium Cup
description: This is the perfect cup to use for parties, sporting events, concerts, festivals, weddings, or to give away as party favors! This USA-made cup is reusable and BPA free, making it a great way to reduce waste on top of being a great way to enjoy your favorite drink. These stadium cups come in a variety of eye-catching colors that will make your brand stand out at any event! 12 oz, 22 oz, 32 oz also available.
summary: Stand out from the mess of thin paper and flimsy Styrofoam cups by with this 16 oz. plastic stadium cup!
